acceptance: The darwin-x86_64 dbgen is run (Intel macOS runner or Rosetta) and its SF 0.01 supplier/customer hashes match the canonical values asserted in tests/unit/core/tpch/test_tpch_dbgen_framing_binaries.py
description: #2622 fixed a signed overflow in UnifInt (rnd.c) that made -O2 builds write non-canonical supplier and customer addresses, and rebuilt both darwin binaries. The darwin-arm64 build was verified (SF1 supplier f5699b5d..., customer a035a33a...); the darwin-x86_64 build was cross-compiled and never executed because Rosetta was unavailable. Its correctness rests on a disassembly comparison only.
